headline: Chilean Peso Weakens Past 1,010 Per Dollar Amid Hawkish US Federal Reserve Outlook
summary: The Chilean peso weakened past 1,010 per US dollar as market expectations for successive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes strengthened.
why: The Chilean peso exchange rate is sensitive to domestic interest rate expectations and copper price fluctuations.

impacts.name: Chilean Peso
impacts.why: The Chilean peso slipped past $1,010 under pressure from a stronger US dollar and hawkish Fed rate expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish Fed policy expectations strengthened the US dollar against emerging market currencies.
